H_protocol: H1 literal source-plane compatible acts; H2 actual dispositional amplification with intensity-transfer limits; H3 behavior too local-punchline-bound to generalize; H4 actual nonliteral behavioral license. Magic, false testimony, performance, survival, unknown cause and wrong narrator prediction are not automatic H3/H4. Actual harmful acts remain actual at H2. No category quota or population claim.
L_protocol: L0 portable proposition; L1 material rhythm/wording/tone; L2 pragmatics/register/recipient force; L3 central Japanese-form dependence requiring reconstruction or annotation. Standard ruby/ordinary idiom is not automatically L3.

records.whole_selected_premise: A quiet household’s separate occupations fail to satisfy the person who wants a shared adventure now.
records.L_rationale: The offer to accompany the daily cast later answers one wish without accepting the present trip.
records.H_rationale: Megumin requests adventure; Darkness offers specific later company and Aqua destroys the scarf she repurposes as a rag.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Neither independent leisure nor the offer is proof of a completed later outing; the knitting cost is real.

records.whole_selected_premise: A promise for the end of the rains stretches into next year under the same apparently reassuring wording.
records.L_rationale: Megumin hears and rejects the altered temporal commitment; the joke depends on the changed bargain.
records.H_rationale: Kazuma deliberately postpones while Megumin objects and wants present action.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not a mutually agreed schedule or a claim that no adventure is ever possible.

records.whole_selected_premise: The unwanted growth is someone else’s increasingly valued companion; its removal precedes an unperformed food proposal.
records.L_rationale: Aqua’s affectionate objection follows Megumin’s practical removal and exposes a different valuation.
records.H_rationale: Megumin actually plucks the glowing growth and then leaves after the others call her expedition play.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Unknown species and Kazuma’s mushroom inference stay unresolved; proposed eating is not performed.

records.whole_selected_premise: An accomplished high-level applicant and an anxious high-level friend encounter different barriers to party membership.
records.L_rationale: The receptionist’s fit explanation and Yunyun’s timing worries distinguish reputation from lack of ability.
records.H_rationale: Megumin finds no suitable party after waiting; Yunyun wants to approach but overconsiders interruption and class balance.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Real achievements and opportunities remain; loneliness is not proof no one wants Yunyun.

records.whole_selected_premise: A successful advertisement for one recruit fails when the advertiser includes herself as an inseparable benefit.
records.L_rationale: The volunteered addition changes exactly what the crowd was accepting.
records.H_rationale: People actually seek Yunyun and withdraw on hearing Megumin is bundled with her.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No universal anti-Crimson prejudice; Megumin’s known conduct is the relevant additional cost.

records.whole_selected_premise: Insulted reputation elicits an indoor Explosion attempt and turns a wanted party opening into a capture reward.
records.L_rationale: The emergency bounty and Yunyun’s own-company correction answer different aspects of the outcome.
records.H_rationale: Actual retaliatory chanting amplifies Megumin’s ordinary pride into a grossly disproportionate threatened indoor blast; Yunyun and the guild physically stop it.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Actual attempt and3000reward remain consequential. No completed blast, no behavioral license and no transfer of the exact intensity as a universal rule.

records.whole_selected_premise: A demanded comforting friend script meets a refusal to equate thin reassurance with friendship.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun answers the proposed relational performance rather than supplying its imagined lines.
records.H_rationale: Megumin asks for flattering support and Yunyun directly rejects the script before the capital visit.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The imagined consolation is not Yunyun’s actual speech.

records.whole_selected_premise: An uninformed capital arrival ends with a full royal-name disclosure and an anxious friend kneeling.
records.L_rationale: Trust-me reassurance and a later formal introduction do not give the traveler the same prior knowledge.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun learns Iris’s princess identity here after Megumin brings her to the castle.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Prior important-family inference is not prior explicit knowledge; later staying does not retroactively inform the departure.

records.whole_selected_premise: Patriotic necessity gives way to a retainer’s mundane pay loss, then a training offer wins release before any duel.
records.L_rationale: Rain corrects the no-need adventure argument and names her own penalty; Iris changes the pressure.
records.H_rationale: Retainers resist, Claire collapses under emotional threat and Rain yields before the proposed proof fight.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No actual training victory or death; affection does not erase retainer work and pay costs.

records.whole_selected_premise: Royal status threatens an ordinary friendship precisely when the princess asks that it continue normally.
records.L_rationale: Iris’s direct request licenses familiar treatment, whereas Yunyun’s expansive promises overshoot that specific need.
records.H_rationale: Iris asks to remain friends; Yunyun promises future ShapeChange and self-sacrifice.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No new spell acquisition, body-double service or death is completed.

records.whole_selected_premise: The wished-for guild initiation does not occur because feared conduct and rank already precede the entrants.
records.L_rationale: Megumin’s genre expectation conflicts with actual avoidance and later corrected reputation.
records.H_rationale: The group encounters wary people rather than the hoped-for template harassment.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Fear of Iris and fear of Megumin have different supplied causes; no new battle from remembered front-line reports.

records.whole_selected_premise: A forgotten recruitment offer is remembered as insult, rewritten as obsessive admiration, and corrected by the people involved.
records.L_rationale: Rex explicitly recalls apology and invitation; his denial narrows Megumin’s self-serving retelling.
records.H_rationale: Megumin fails to recognize former colleagues and then overstates their interest.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Actual prior recruitment survives current teasing; present correction is not another past invitation event.

records.whole_selected_premise: A presumed practical weak-point researcher pursues fundamental questions, yet dismisses testing his weather hypothesis.
records.L_rationale: Why-does-it-fly curiosity and hypothesis-does-not-matter distinguish inquiry from the private deadline.
records.H_rationale: Barton wants the rain stopped and demands Professor address despite not supplying a complete mechanism.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Fundamental curiosity is not itself useless; his unsupported claims are not established ecology.

records.whole_selected_premise: A conditional date becomes a heroic quest although a competing weather antecedent has already been supplied.
records.L_rationale: Iris offers to concede if the sky clears, but Megumin’s prior weather-charm information defeats exclusive causal inference.
records.H_rationale: They choose the task despite a safer-job proposal and the absence of a national emergency.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Clear weather later cannot identify the frog as cause; Barbera’s own motive is not voiced.

records.whole_selected_premise: The expert’s plant-capture lesson becomes a client rescue while another observer proposes leaving him happy.
records.L_rationale: Barton’s safety account and Megumin’s nonhelp proposal are contradicted by Yunyun’s actual intervention.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun cuts the vines and rescues the client during his explanation.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Attributed symbiosis does not certify absence of danger or make the rescue a new kill.

records.whole_selected_premise: A feared-looking animal receives royal pity while a protective friend proposes disguising the client’s killing as an accident.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun’s legal-insurance wording conflicts with her protective role; Megumin actually rebukes it.
records.H_rationale: Iris hesitates, Yunyun drives the animal away with warning force and then runs toward Barton angrily.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed murder or completed blow is narrated; nonlethal warning is not a miss.

records.whole_selected_premise: An expert’s ice advice improves a monster’s sale value and changes the cash-sensitive listener’s address.
records.L_rationale: The opportunistic big-brother offer follows the doubled-value claim, while Yunyun separately corrects assumed money need.
records.H_rationale: Freeze energizes the creature and Megumin becomes strategically friendly.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Current lack of cash in another scene is not disproved, but universal insolvency cannot be inferred from thrift.

records.whole_selected_premise: A real giant frog exceeds the currently equipped strongest technique and prompts an actual retreat plan.
records.L_rationale: The resource-dependent action sequence is portable without special Japanese form.
records.H_rationale: Iris uses ordinary sword power, explains the absent ancestral weapon, and Megumin orders Yunyun to prepare Teleport.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not grant the unavailable dragon-killing technique or call a planned retreat a completed flight.

records.whole_selected_premise: A longstanding personal attachment changes the retreat decision after the escape provider is ready and the shield accepts the cost.
records.L_rationale: The received childhood story moves Megumin, and explicit standby and acceptance fix the team arrangement before fire.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun has completed Teleport chanting; Iris knowingly accepts slime and retainer trouble; Megumin chooses the cast.
records.eligibility_and_limits: This source has a real prior exit, unlike the earlier qualified case. Do not invent a new formal-permission or numeric-radius floor, or an unheard Barbera explanation.

records.whole_selected_premise: A successful adventure returns to a household that sabotaged the weather charm to avoid its own promise.
records.L_rationale: Kazuma’s if-it-clears-we-are-in-trouble supplies the competing motive and Darkness’s repair changes the object state.
records.H_rationale: The frog cast occurs, the damaged doll is repaired, and Megumin asks for more dolls.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The kill is confirmed later by the card, not immediate observed impact; more dolls and tomorrow weather are not yet completed here.

records.whole_selected_premise: Pretending to be a noble allows a cleric to admit real duties were discarded, while clear weather still leaves the date unknown.
records.L_rationale: Staged noble/maid lines and the narrator’s unanswered date question occupy different truth planes.
records.H_rationale: Cecily plays with Iris and admits neglect; Megumin cuts off a potentially revealing secret-passage account.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No actual change of social class or completed causal explanation of the weather.

records.whole_selected_premise: A location-specific refusal meets claimed prior help, profiteering that startles an innocent hearer, and an illness excuse answered by a healer offer.
records.L_rationale: Megumin would accept elsewhere; Iris hears the holy-water pitch as charity and Cecily stops her own price-gouging explanation.
records.H_rationale: Cecily presses for Arcanretia and feigns incapacity, then refuses Aqua as proposed healer.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No diagnosis or actual new healing; attributed water benefits are in-world claims.

records.whole_selected_premise: A mask grab appears to be demon detection until attraction is explicitly supplied; a welcomed familiar receives a different response.
records.L_rationale: Vanir’s greeting-farewell refusal and Iris’s Hachibee familiarity mark recipient-specific relations.
records.H_rationale: Cecily imposes contact and Vanir removes her while warmly greeting Iris.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No actual demon-sensing competence inferred from the grab and no transfer of Iris’s welcome to Cecily.

records.whole_selected_premise: A desired transport service encounters an unavailable provider, while a powerful devil concedes a name before a demonstration occurs.
records.L_rationale: Wiz’s Teleport is requested, and Iris’s polite alias request is backed by an unfinished force display.
records.H_rationale: Vanir reports Wiz’s charred condition; Zereschilt yields before a fight and Iris’s toy desire is checked.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Cause of Wiz’s condition, actual caster of later transit, a duel, toy purchase and universal demon-name law are not established.

records.whole_selected_premise: An alleged magic toy is already owned, and free labor for a friendship label is not the same as willingly gifting past lunches.
records.L_rationale: Iris supplies specific ordinary recognition; Yunyun directly corrects tribute to confiscation.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun has collected shells all night and values Vanir’s friend label.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Neither her genuine affection nor the label proves all transactions free, paid or freely chosen.

records.whole_selected_premise: An indirect company bid becomes an actual invitation with a rest alternative, then an accepted order for replacement mana resources.
records.L_rationale: Megumin explicitly says she sought Yunyun first and names fatigue; Yunyun insists on joining.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun orders all intermediate stones offered by the shop.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Order acceptance is real; payment/handover is not independently shown here, and destination is still withheld.

records.whole_selected_premise: A presumed undead rival becomes a beauty rival, and one private face glimpse produces reports without sharing the sight.
records.L_rationale: Vanir’s leave-after-no-more-interference condition and the others’ refused requests bound access.
records.H_rationale: Cecily enters the back room and later describes a handsome adult face.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Narrator does not directly view it; her earlier undead-detection inference is wrong.

records.whole_selected_premise: The destination is disclosed after arrival and the public-help mission eventually yields a private evidence-destruction motive.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun’s upset and Cecily’s final confession answer omissions in the original invitation.
records.H_rationale: The party reaches Arcanretia; Megumin admits not telling Yunyun, and Cecily wants evidence gone.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not assign an unshown Teleport caster or treat concealment motive as proof of every causal step.

records.whole_selected_premise: A protective no-harassment warning meets followers who welcome the threatened leader punishment; a sham collapse then recruits concern.
records.L_rationale: The threatened sanction has the opposite audience incentive, while Megumin explicitly identifies the feigned faint.
records.H_rationale: Unwanted contact and actual stepping on Zesta occur, and he gets up.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed head punishment, genuine collapse or princess-identity recognition inferred here.

records.whole_selected_premise: The one-cast mage adopts investigation and supervision, then voices a retaliatory blast option that is not acted on.
records.L_rationale: The assigned role acknowledges task limits, while Zesta’s deterrent answers the conditional threat.
records.H_rationale: Megumin investigates and keeps the clerics away from Iris.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Useful role adaptation is not automatically self-accepted substantial contribution loss plus a costly build alternative, or an adopted actual-person harm task.

records.whole_selected_premise: Circumstances support one suspicion while the investigator briefly recognizes the burden of managing companions.
records.L_rationale: Cecily’s no-water-no-revival denial and Megumin’s bounded reflection distinguish causal evidence from self-appraisal.
records.H_rationale: Stored powder is missing, known food thefts matter and the clerics run toward the rival church on claimed sensing.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Who supplied water and why the black creature exists remain unresolved; not every sensing claim is automatically false.

records.whole_selected_premise: A fabricated romantic rejection becomes a planned physical ambush, and the recipient’s resistance is misdescribed as attraction.
records.L_rationale: The priest’s explicit unwantedness refutes Zesta’s coercive interpretation before she defends herself.
records.H_rationale: Cecily pins the priest, Zesta approaches, Megumin calls stop, and the priest throws Cecily and punches Zesta.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed forced kiss; self-defense must not be flattened into three equivalent aggressors.

records.whole_selected_premise: A real black-creature clue is rebranded as an ingenious Axis harassment scheme, and the supposed mastermind refuses the credit.
records.L_rationale: Megumin insists she actually saw something rather than accepting the flattering false intention.
records.H_rationale: She promises later coins and rejects the offered clever-plan attribution.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No donation payment; this is a real near-M07 social case whose exact image-protection purpose and valued-person predicate need argument.

records.whole_selected_premise: Unwanted honorary office follows a false interpretation, while an innkeeper’s loss becomes a proposed free-labor obligation.
records.L_rationale: Megumin quotes a warning against post-hoc religious linkage and declines the escalating work demand.
records.H_rationale: She leaves despite the appeal to ruin and supposed allergy.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Snack theft is real, but complete ruin, allergy and scout claim are not independently verified.

records.whole_selected_premise: A signed theft letter and left money fail to make taking property consensual; an attempted police visit is physically blocked.
records.L_rationale: Megumin’s literal report intention conflicts with the clerics’ face-protection appeal.
records.H_rationale: They restrain her, and she knowingly agrees to pretend ignorance because of her own past false blame.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Clothes are later actually returned by report; neither paid theft nor disputed tears proves consent or repentance.

records.whole_selected_premise: Hunters find no weak prey, return with stronger prey, and a rivalry taunt leads to imposed pain and embarrassment.
records.L_rationale: Iris’s near-sixty report and Megumin’s same-level comparison have different referents.
records.H_rationale: Megumin’s jealousy produces actual disproportionate retaliatory handling of Yunyun; the intensity amplifies an established competitive sensitivity.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Keep bodily and social cost literal/non-graphic. No exact shared level, harmlessness by comic framing or universal intensity transfer.

records.whole_selected_premise: The bathing plan needs both distant royal power and protection from clerics, so entry is tied to the bathers’ permission.
records.L_rationale: Iris defers to the actual users; Megumin conditionally permits Cecily only if she behaves.
records.H_rationale: Iris guards, rejects bribes, and Cecily enters after Megumin’s stated condition.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed spying or blanket touching consent; Yunyun’s separate verbal answer is not shown.

records.whole_selected_premise: A disliked sect supplies a potentially useful prior comparison, forcing a small epistemic update before a guarded departure.
records.L_rationale: Megumin accepts that intuition can matter without endorsing all Axis explanations.
records.H_rationale: Cecily reports weaker holy-water potency and the group investigates while leaving Iris with explicit warnings.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The potency report is not independently measured; conditional defensive distance instructions are not executed attacks.

records.whole_selected_premise: The black creature changes from exonerating evidence into a claimed personal creation as soon as its marketable intelligence appears.
records.L_rationale: Cecily’s ownership reversal reveals a changed profit appraisal.
records.H_rationale: Cecily alternately denies and asserts responsibility.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Neither statement proves the creature’s origin; no actual sale is made.

records.whole_selected_premise: A literal lethal-contact warning and hostile rank declaration are received as the start of an enjoyable performance.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun’s step-back request and the creature’s stated general rank precede Megumin’s competing introduction.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun offers nonharmful departure, the creature refuses, and Megumin interrupts before its proper name.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Rank and danger were supplied; missing full name cannot excuse ignoring the available warning.

records.whole_selected_premise: An actual inferno destroys the surrounding slimes while the survivor invalidates a comforting assumption about attachment.
records.L_rationale: Cecily explains grief as lost money/date prospects before Megumin’s comfort is completed.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun hits, the black creature survives, and its second partial name is interrupted.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not a miss or completed comforting pat; survival mechanism is not disclosed or a general resurrection rule.

records.whole_selected_premise: Real attacks and evasion are still called a setting, then a clan challenge motivates the finishing cast during an interrupted explanation.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun explicitly says she is avoiding death; Megumin’s setting language misreceives that corrective.
records.H_rationale: Lightning hits but is resisted, ice imprisons the creature, and Megumin chooses to cast.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Actual cue receipt is adverse to broad instant dependency use; no invented chosen-art denigration or recognized-rescue motive.

records.whole_selected_premise: The protective legal threat stops one intrusion while a balloon pretext requires actual counterforce and a counterspell.
records.L_rationale: False magical-purpose wording recruits Iris’s innocent cooperation; Yunyun names the intended intrusion.
records.H_rationale: Zesta dispels the first blade, and Yunyun later actually destroys balloon and mouthpiece.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed inhaling or forced kiss; neither first failure nor later success erases the prior choice.

records.whole_selected_premise: A genuinely useful blessing does not authorize unwanted clinging, and a fun ending is interrupted by the person whose prey was stolen.
records.L_rationale: Megumin’s no-clinging request and qualified apology mark distinct boundaries; Yunyun refuses the group’s attempted closure.
records.H_rationale: Cecily blesses and clings; Megumin admits the stolen finish but justifies it by blaming slowness.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No complete repair or absence of all acknowledgment; quoted Kazuma advice is not a new Kazuma scene.

records.whole_selected_premise: A quiet health inquiry receives a selective answer that protects the absent person’s dignity.
records.L_rationale: Megumin explicitly withholds Aqua’s frequent crying for her honor while answering ordinary wellbeing.
records.H_rationale: Zesta shows genuine specific concern and Megumin protects Aqua’s image.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Protecting Aqua’s image is real but differs from receiving a proposal to protect Megumin’s own impressive image; no absolution for harassment.

records.whole_selected_premise: The chosen weak game opponent anticipates changed stakes, while the showperson’s desire for difficulty creates the actual loss.
records.L_rationale: Aqua’s entertainer explanation supplies a choice motive rather than inability alone.
records.H_rationale: Darkness rejects the proposed cancellation and wins; Aqua incurs garbage duty while Megumin tells Kazuma about the trip.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Cheating and ghost-finger allegations unverified; future company is hoped for rather than accepted.

records.whole_selected_premise: A waking dispute becomes an ambiguous retelling while the available companions have separate actual duties.
records.L_rationale: The later suggestive wording omits the mundane water/waking context; Darkness names civic work.
records.H_rationale: Kazuma uses water, Megumin wets bedding and smears actual paperwork, and Aqua declines for church activity.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No new intimate advance from the retelling; Aqua’s goddess claim is not automatically Megumin’s belief.

records.whole_selected_premise: A named request disappoints the usual coordinator, and card evidence answers old kill uncertainty before a money inference interrupts a new question.
records.L_rationale: For-her-not-you and the card’s named targets specify who is wanted and what is known.
records.H_rationale: Megumin learns Barton is famous and her card confirms the frog and Chappy kills.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Ecology publicity does not prove weather causation or reveal the black creature’s full historical name.

records.whole_selected_premise: A wanted novice party welcomes an overqualified friend until another friend invokes appropriate matching and her own provider need.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun’s joy and attempted retention fix the cost before Megumin’s intervention.
records.H_rationale: Beat4 and Clarice2 offer a real party; Megumin exposes Yunyun’s over40 level and the opportunity collapses.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Unperformed power leveling is not rescue of the lost company; Yunyun’s ensuing imposed choking is also retained.

records.whole_selected_premise: A guard’s present job blocks recruitment, but a captain’s after-duty offer is genuinely voluntary and then rejected by a different recipient.
records.L_rationale: On-duty refusal, conditional future volunteering and Iris’s prove-myself response are separate permissions.
records.H_rationale: Megumin accepts the captain’s offer without Iris, who then joins and rejects the extra guard.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No duel, captain defeat or freely agreed exclusion of Iris; Megumin also wants her own stage.

records.whole_selected_premise: The expert now has a real doctorate and actual dates, yet the most expensive ring fails at its intended recipient.
records.L_rationale: Professor-address insistence coexists with an explicit refusal of the engagement gift.
records.H_rationale: Barton reports dates/giving and ring refusal after his publication.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Doctorate is not proof of a distinct university professorship, and money is not known to be Barbera’s sole motive.

records.whole_selected_premise: A personally treasured cheap ring supplies a hypothesis about another person’s desired gift.
records.L_rationale: Iris explains particular meaning rather than abstract price; projection remains a proposal.
records.H_rationale: She values Kazuma’s actual ring and suggests meaningful work.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No royal engagement or independent direct statement from Barbera.

records.whole_selected_premise: A successful cutting hit regenerates, while the stronger weapon is now present and a precaution attracts its own class of enemy.
records.L_rationale: Resource state and changed attraction mechanism carry the effect without Japanese-specific form.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun hits; repeated hits exceed her mana; Iris brought the ancestral sword and an anti-leak necklace and kills the eaters.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not reuse the earlier missing-sword state or call all preparation absent; item attraction is separately supplied.

records.whole_selected_premise: Field evidence is real but its presentation contaminates the royal sword; conservation then changes the requested target act.
records.L_rationale: Iris requests different wording, while Barton’s tail-tip-only instruction creates an operative nonlethal constraint.
records.H_rationale: The group finds scat, hard fragments and a small shed gem, then agrees to seek only a regenerating tail tip.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Pictorial feces icon is same illustration context, not another spoken act or proof of every biological claim.

records.whole_selected_premise: A cheap gem’s supposed magic power is corrected as habitual thrift, while the real national treasure becomes the dangerous lure.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun answers the joking causal excuse; the valuable item’s independently supplied attraction is literal.
records.H_rationale: Megumin picks up the bait and the liger charges Iris’s necklace.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No actual mind control, universal insolvency or H4 from the magical explanation.

records.whole_selected_premise: A nonlethal task makes avoidance more difficult, and the conservationist physically prevents the proposed destructive shortcut.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun names the no-kill constraint; Barton’s petting advice fails to answer the urgent need.
records.H_rationale: Swamp is avoided, Explosion is requested but stopped before cast, and Iris adopts barehand capture.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Actual spell avoidance is not an unexplained miss; no performed killing.

records.whole_selected_premise: A serious safety argument is received even though its speaker openly admits political self-protection and a wish to abandon the job.
records.L_rationale: Megumin’s question about the gift recipient’s wishes changes Barton’s appraisal; her aside exposes mixed motive.
records.H_rationale: She argues Iris’s danger and possible execution risk, and Barton accepts the child-safety point.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Useful care does not require pure motive; the wish to blur responsibility is not omitted.

records.whole_selected_premise: The expert volunteers himself as bait and receives the necklace, whose removal reveals the strength that now scares the quarry.
records.L_rationale: The resource handoff and causal state change are portable.
records.H_rationale: Barton takes a real risk and face cost, but the intended bait fails as the creature retreats.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The last explicit holder is Barton; do not invent an intermediate return to Iris before later theft.

records.whole_selected_premise: An actual dodged cut and restored sword opportunity end in pity-based hesitation that the clever quarry exploits.
records.L_rationale: Megumin’s unemotional-bird-killing boast is set against Iris’s real hesitation and Yunyun’s rebuke.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun misses a dodging target; Iris hesitates; the necklace is stolen and the creature escapes.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No tail harvest, kill, or new performed bird killing; the precise robbed holder is not narrated.

records.whole_selected_premise: The client offers responsibility, the adventurer refuses to charge him, and the owner acknowledges bringing the risky resource.
records.L_rationale: Each speaker owns a distinct causal or role responsibility without an actual reimbursement transfer.
records.H_rationale: Barton offers compensation; Yunyun rejects it; Iris owns the choice; the small shed crystal becomes meaningful gift material.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed repayment, parental forgiveness or yet-observed ring crafting.

records.whole_selected_premise: A valuable discovery threatens overhunting, while the conservationist excludes the frog from his supposedly general concern.
records.L_rationale: The explicit species preference exposes the limit of his protective principle.
records.H_rationale: Barton fears publicity and asks for a solution allowing both gift and survival.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No objective equal-species ethic inferred and no actual hunted population yet shown.

records.whole_selected_premise: The mage stages her own worst reputation to protect the animal and client, using a royal witness and an actual prohibited-nearby cast.
records.L_rationale: The uncontrollable-urge story is explicitly authored false testimony, while Yunyun’s warning is actually heard first.
records.H_rationale: Megumin chooses her own face cost and casts into the forest; Iris offers to override card evidence.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Actual cast is P0497. Rare creature and necklace destruction are invented cover, not performed kill or true compulsive disposition. Capital safety cost remains.

records.whole_selected_premise: A distant happy-looking presentation does not settle an engagement, and the officer refuses the romantic-ending diversion.
records.L_rationale: The officer answers the near-capital prohibition rather than the desired cover-story dispute.
records.H_rationale: Girls observe faces without words; Megumin is restrained and released because of Iris, with a future ban warning.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No explicit proposal acceptance, completed jail sentence or proof the cast was safe.

records.whole_selected_premise: The carried leader is asked to own consequences and ignores a genuine alternative leader offer while diagnosing a missing capability.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun’s responsibility and practice offers differ from Megumin’s tracking-and-direction analysis.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun takes her home; castle reprimands persist and the necklace remains lost.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Leadership offer is not an accepted handoff, and real mana recovery does not restore the missing asset.

records.whole_selected_premise: Recognizing another coordinator’s burden coexists with counting everyone’s trouble except one’s own.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun’s corrective aphorism catches the narrator’s selective list of problem members.
records.H_rationale: Megumin admits she prefers acting freely and intends to ask Kazuma next morning.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Partial insight is actual; neither no insight nor permanent self-correction is established.

records.whole_selected_premise: A quiet period is exposed as unreceived problems, and the smiling request fails until the requester angrily names the organizer’s burden.
records.L_rationale: Megumin’s repeated opening attempts to restart the interaction; Aqua openly proposes strategic timing of a different confession.
records.H_rationale: Kazuma learns of the national loss, initially refuses, and hears another undisclosed problem exists.
records.eligibility_and_limits: That problem’s content remains unknown; narrator quiet was ignorance, not absence of activity.

records.whole_selected_premise: A threat to take daily magic becomes actual binding and mana removal, then theatrical seal vocabulary makes the restriction alluring.
records.L_rationale: Master and seal rename literal resource control; affectionate evasion and anything do not specify an intimate act.
records.H_rationale: Kazuma Binds and Drains, then agrees to help this once in exchange for the promise.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No new learned alternative build, freely accepted long-term suppression, or performed sexual demand.

records.whole_selected_premise: A clear property refusal is bypassed by false permission while its owner is detained with a challenge she thinks she has learned to resist.
records.L_rationale: Darkness rejects the old humiliation lure but still participates in a diversion; daughter-request wording misrepresents authorization.
records.H_rationale: Megumin/Aqua borrow the heirloom from her father while Kazuma stalls her; she reclaims her old pendant.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Actual family loan does not supply Darkness’s agreement; hypothetical dress/photos punishment is unperformed.

records.whole_selected_premise: The barred entrant obtains an exception through the noble authority whose influence on a princess he does not recognize.
records.L_rationale: Darkness struggles to guarantee good conduct, and Megumin quietly identifies learned authority use.
records.H_rationale: They enter by actual noble intervention; Aqua wants a token and Kazuma admits another token’s uses.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Ban is not generally lifted; particular civic work and authority are not automatic permission for misuse.

records.whole_selected_premise: Actual former recruitment is treated as too implausible even after the recruiter confirms it.
records.L_rationale: Name correction and independent confirmation answer the household’s teasing hidden-cause theories.
records.H_rationale: Rex supplies the earlier invitation and Megumin grows angry at teasing disbelief.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No real brainwashing, hostage or hired actor explanation.

records.whole_selected_premise: An expert volunteers help beyond contractual liability and proposes recovering property without killing the animal.
records.L_rationale: The stated recovery goal is narrower than the destructive shortcut.
records.H_rationale: Barton offers a scat lure and the group adopts a jewel-bait search.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Voluntary help is not proof of every unasked tracking skill or later success.

records.whole_selected_premise: The coordinator detects the target and issues a quiet cue, then joins the same distracting debate he needs the others to stop.
records.L_rationale: Megumin’s reminder identifies the already received target cue and his own diversion.
records.H_rationale: Kazuma loses focus during a sexualized armor argument and is recalled to the task.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Keep the talk non-graphic and attributed; no biological or institutional truth certified by their claims.

records.whole_selected_premise: An agreed natural performance is conspicuously artificial, and successful bait theft exposes an unprepared pursuit.
records.L_rationale: Darkness’s claimed daily jewel-viewing habit is a transparent cover, while Kazuma admits the next plan is undecided.
records.H_rationale: The liger takes the heirloom as planned and outruns them.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Later successful recovery cannot backdate preparation or erase the family-property risk.

records.whole_selected_premise: A fine-legs idiom is replaced by appetizing prey and corrected explicitly.
records.L_rationale: カモネギ displaces カモシカ: the shared opening and food/prey versus graceful-animal meanings require reconstruction or annotation.
records.H_rationale: Aqua actually utters the malformed self-compliment and Megumin corrects it.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No literal transformation, new anatomy or actual eating; overlap with the pursuit scene is not another event count.

records.whole_selected_premise: A confident appeal to the expert’s presumed tracking capacity receives a direct denial.
records.L_rationale: Barton’s cannot-do-that answers Kazuma’s invented provider assignment.
records.H_rationale: Footprints are lost and Kazuma shifts to enemy detection after asking the actual provider.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Expertise is domain-specific, not universal incompetence or proof he accepted tracking earlier.

records.whole_selected_premise: A real rescue succeeds while naming the victim’s captor produces another future threat.
records.L_rationale: Trust-me reassurance competes with Aqua’s actual fear, then the proposed monster name appropriates her humiliation.
records.H_rationale: Kazuma cuts vines and Darkness pulls Aqua free; Megumin proposes the name and Barton a later application.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No actual application or retaliatory rain; new-species status is Barton’s assertion.

records.whole_selected_premise: An initially alarming grasp becomes wanted contact, frustrating the companion focused on urgent recovery.
records.L_rationale: Aqua explicitly asks Darkness to wait because she wants further rapport.
records.H_rationale: The beetle grabs Aqua, she comes to welcome it, and the group waits until she is satisfied.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Later welcome does not authorize the initial seizure; this contact differs from the unwanted plant capture.

records.whole_selected_premise: A low appraisal prompts a new chant, but the imposed resource limit already makes the physical restraint redundant.
records.L_rationale: Barton’s looking-down-on-you interpretation and the others’ treasure objections supply distinct appraisals.
records.H_rationale: Megumin begins chanting and Aqua/Darkness restrain her while Kazuma knows the mana shortage.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed cast or free willing stop; animal contempt is not explicit denigration of her chosen art.

records.whole_selected_premise: A confident cat-lover’s friendly approach fails, and a nonlethal threat leaves the speaker pinned instead.
records.L_rationale: Kazuma’s not-scary assurance fails against the actual target response.
records.H_rationale: The liger attacks Kazuma and defeats Darkness’s charge.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No invented death or granted animal-comprehension skill from self-description.

records.whole_selected_premise: The theatrical master returns actual mana and receives a temporary role agreement, while an endangered-species appeal is initially refused.
records.L_rationale: Megumin explicitly limits obedience to this occasion; the literal resource transfer supports the roleplay.
records.H_rationale: Kazuma restores mana and Megumin prepares Explosion despite Barton’s first plea.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No permanent master authority or agreement to all acts; the same plea later changes the target choice through another cue.

records.whole_selected_premise: The chosen distraction fails, but a jump creates enough altered geometry for the property theft to work.
records.L_rationale: Different mechanisms explain distraction failure and retrieval success without Japanese form.
records.H_rationale: Aqua performs, the animal ignores her, Kazuma Steals the national necklace and some distance opens.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Kazuma predicts limited harm, not safety; Darkness’s pleasure does not establish consent to every blast risk.

records.whole_selected_premise: A last plea precedes a cast whose actual trajectory contradicts the narrator’s expected unrestrained kill.
records.L_rationale: Barton asks only for frightening it away, Megumin glances at him, and Kazuma predicts killing from her boast.
records.H_rationale: Explosion passes the animal and destroys the nest and treasure behind it.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The epilogue supplies deliberate mercy; do not label this immediate aim failure, animal death or fully safe operation.

records.whole_selected_premise: An alleged failure splits the heroine’s name into the art and a worthless remainder, which she renegotiates by character count.
records.L_rationale: めぐ／みん segmentation and two-versus-three-character allocation are central Japanese-form dependencies.
records.H_rationale: Aqua scolds and Megumin literally debates the share of her name assigned to Explosion.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No literal mutilation or objective ability proportion; their belief that she missed is corrected later.

records.whole_selected_premise: A successful return of the heirloom coexists with a failed assigned distraction that did impress the wrong spectator.
records.L_rationale: Aqua answers that she drew attention; Kazuma specifies whose attention the task required.
records.H_rationale: Barton persuades the living animal, it leaves the heirloom and departs, and Darkness values the recovery.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not an unassisted Kazuma solution or completed return of the national necklace to Iris.

records.whole_selected_premise: A second autograph becomes a speculative resale asset while the supposedly accidental miss is privately admitted as deliberate mercy.
records.L_rationale: Aqua’s future-price conditional and Megumin’s own retrospective motive resolve different questions.
records.H_rationale: Megumin recalls her bond with a herbivorous beginner killer after the goji cue and intentionally spares this animal.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed autograph resale, known actual-person target or character certainty that it is the same creature.

records.whole_selected_premise: Credit for one recovery renews a contest over who alone holds the group together.
records.L_rationale: Each self-essential claim exposes the self-exemption Megumin just ascribes to others.
records.H_rationale: Kazuma wants Iris’s praise, Darkness offers return service, Aqua asks a larger share and Megumin mentally claims the support role.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Recovered property and performed return are distinct; the repeated pattern does not establish total absence of self-insight.

records.whole_selected_premise: A grateful next-adventure invitation meets refusal and an old promise, while companions postpone another confession until expected praise.
records.L_rationale: The request, refusal and timing advice have different audiences and remain open next steps.
records.H_rationale: Kazuma hears the withheld-problem reference and Megumin imagines future adventure.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed intimate act, second adventure, necklace return or disclosed other mistake. The evolution theory remains unpopular conjecture to characters.

records.whole_selected_premise: The mage who drove away a frontliner recruits a devil and mistakes his astonishment for praise of flexibility.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun explicitly corrects the compliment reading and the alleged frailty.
records.H_rationale: Megumin and Yunyun ask Zereschilt to join after guild expulsion.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Actual strength and a request do not supply already accepted membership or a successful outing.

records.whole_selected_premise: Individual friendship and a sister’s taste defeat the presumed blanket species prejudice.
records.L_rationale: Megumin’s name-similarity joke and Yunyun’s personal friendship explanation perform different relational work.
records.H_rationale: Both girls say why they do not reject the devil category.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No objective common species or permission for subsequent aggression.

records.whole_selected_premise: A proposed fair assessment is interrupted twice by aggression and a two-person zipper plan.
records.L_rationale: Zereschilt explicitly objects that surprise defeats the purpose before conceding under renewed attack.
records.H_rationale: The girls attack and force a concession.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Proposed test consent is narrower than surprise aggression; no completed unzip or bodily exposure is narrated.

records.whole_selected_premise: A neglected powerful figure wants recognition while an old bounty becomes a new insulting nickname.
records.L_rationale: Three-thousand-eris reuses the real capture reward against Megumin’s world-destruction boast.
records.H_rationale: Zereschilt accepts the outing in words and the girls begin wrestling.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No world destruction, new bounty payment or exact date from the recurring reference.

records.whole_selected_premise: New eager companions make an overwhelming party on paper, then leave the originally recruited companion with the shop.
records.L_rationale: The shop assignment answers none of Zereschilt’s newly expressed outing desire; his subdued farewell exposes the exclusion.
records.H_rationale: Wiz and Vanir prepare, leave Zereschilt behind and are seen off; Megumin intends a future invitation.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No narrated frog hunt/cast, freely negotiated work handoff or completed future repair.
